# `jouet plugin`

- **Usage:** `jouet plugin <SUBCOMMAND>`

Add, remove, list and fetch plugins: rules and routines pinned by commit

A plugin is a git repository, or a directory, with a jouet-plugin.toml (its name, description and the oldest jouet it works with) and rules/, routines/ or both. Its rules and routines are named after it: `acme/no-prod-db`, `joue acme/deploy`. `add` pins a git plugin at a full commit and the hash of every file it ships, in ~/.config/jouet/plugins.toml, or with --repo in this repository's .jouet/plugins.toml (which then needs trusting again). Every hook checks the kept files against the hash, and never fetches; `sync` fetches the pins missing or changed. /etc/jouet/plugins.toml and /etc/jouet/plugins/ hold enforced plugins.
